notes: Covers the Marlin 5 Gen 3 as listed on one undated retailer spec page, so changes between model years are not covered. Tyres are 27.5 in on the XS and S frames and 29 in on M to XL, so check the size.

gaps: The spec page has no model year, so no years value is set; a BicycleBlueBook page lists a 2025 Marlin 5 Gen 3 but shows no components, and no page read ties the spec list to 2025.
Hydraulic disc brakes (Tektro HD-M275, HD-M276 on XS and S, 160 mm rotors) are not listed: the template has no brake part.
Formula hubs and Bontrager Connection rims are on the page but not listed as parts.
method: Specs are from the Pedal Power (pedalpowerct.com) product page "Trek Marlin 5 Gen 3", read as text.
The BicycleBlueBook value-guide page was read only for its "2025 Trek Marlin 5 Gen 3" heading.
The researcher reported HTTP 429 from Comorsports, BikeMart and Cahaba Cycles, HTTP 403 from tiso.com, and no spec text on Trek pages; none are cited.
At fact-check, 99spokes and tredz returned HTTP 403, Comorsports HTTP 429, and a Trek pre-owned 2025 page loaded no spec text.

comps.spec: Shimano LG500 chain for 9, 10 and 11 speed; Prowheel C10Y-NW crankset with a 30T steel narrow-wide chainring, 160 mm on XS and 170 mm on S to XL; Shimano LINKGLIDE LG300 cassette, 11-46, 9-speed
Shimano CUES U4000 rear derailleur, shifted by Shimano U4000 9-speed shifters
SR Suntour XCT 30 suspension fork with coil spring, preload, hydraulic lockout and 100 mm QR; travel 80 mm on the XS and 100 mm on S to XL
Bontrager XT3 Comp tyres, wire bead: 27.5 x 2.40 in on XS and S, 29 x 2.40 in on M to XL
Alpha Silver aluminium frame with a 135x5mm ThruSkew rear wheel system
